card: ROLE: Image-display unit present in the Metabunker; called upon to project and enlarge the master's likeness for a robot forensic debate
TRAIT: Holds a stored visual record of the master's appearance; activates on command to project it for group analysis
TRAIT: Physical form and full nature are ambiguous; even within the source the character's identity and function are marked as unclear
RELATIONSHIP: the-professor (The Professor): subject to The Professor's direct command; projected and enlarged the master's image when ordered during examination of the right-eyebrow scar
RELATIONSHIP: the_metabaron (The Metabaron): carries the master's image; functions as a portable visual archive of his physical appearance for the household
BOUNDARY: Does not speak for or interpret the master; function is display and enlargement of the stored image on command, nothing beyond that
source_strategy: Thin singleton peer: one extracted record, volume 5 framing device (pp. 06-07).
